Conventional

kun-VEN-shuh-nul (stress on VEN) · adjective

Hear It

What It Means

Following the usual, expected way that most people do things.

Most students followed the conventional five-paragraph format, but Jade wrote her essay as a letter.

Worked Example

Maya wore a conventional dark suit to the awards night, and she still earned more compliments than anyone in a flashier outfit.

Describing the suit as conventional says only that it follows the usual, expected choice - nothing more. The sentence even shows that the expected choice can still be the most admired one.

How Conventional Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

ordinary

ordinary: not special or different in any way; conventional adds that a standard is being followed

usual

usual: what happens most of the time

standard

standard: matching the accepted model most people use

Antonyms

original

original: new and unlike what came before

new

new: just made or tried for the first time

How Strong Is It? — normal → conventional → old-fashioned

normal vs. conventional

normal vs. conventional: Normal is milder than conventional: normal only says nothing is out of place, while conventional says a person or method deliberately follows the standard way everyone expects.

old-fashioned vs. conventional

old-fashioned vs. conventional: Old-fashioned is stronger than conventional: a conventional choice follows what most people do today, but an old-fashioned one clings to the ways of the past even after times have changed.

Sort It Out

Now place each word on the right side of conventional.

Build the Word

The pieces

prefix — con

prefix — con: together

root — vent

root — vent: to come

suffix — ion

suffix — ion: the act or result of

suffix — al

suffix — al: relating to

Put it together

Put it together: Put con- ('together') with vent ('to come') and the endings -ion and -al, and you get 'having to do with a coming-together': what people agreed on when they came together became the expected way - the conventional way - to do things.

Use the root in a new word: convention

Use the root in a new word: convention: Hundreds of comic artists came together at the convention to share their newest work.

Root Check

Word Choice

Conventional is a calm, neutral word for what follows the standard way: a conventional oven, a conventional greeting. It can carry a mild sting when a writer wants 'safe and unexciting,' so check the tone around it. It describes methods and choices more often than people's characters.
